reviews.review_title: Warehouse error & ignored paid guarantee — Order GSH17R33N00NS4B
reviews.review_text:
Stop writing template messages, give me my money back, I paid for the warranty?!!!


Your employee sent me a so-called "resolution" asking me to return the items, but this is NOT a real solution. I specifically paid extra for your Return Assurance / Shipping Guarantee to ensure a hassle-free process, yet your team has created endless problems instead of protecting my purchase. As I already stated, a physical return from Azerbaijan to your Dubai hub is legally and logistically impossible for a private citizen due to strict international customs regulations, regardless of who pays for shipping. Your automated system continues to reject my clear, high-quality photos on a uniform background. Since your team ignores the paid guarantee, refuses to issue a direct refund for your own warehouse error, and offers impossible return options, I have already escalated this to an external consumer protection platform and my next step today is contacting my bank to initiate a forced chargeback. Order GSH17R33N00NS4B requires an immediate manual refund without return!

Never had any problems until recently. I ordered several dresses for an event, tried them on, didn’t like them and sent them back. I must’ve tried each dress on for approximately 30 seconds. When I returned them, shein deducted large sums of money for supposedly faulty items. I don’t wear makeup, didn’t try them on near anything which could stain, tried everything on when I wasn’t too warm as to not leave sweat patches. I returned everything in the condition it arrived in, and clearly didn’t wear anything long enough to spot any stains.

One order contained 3 red dresses. The photos of the “damage” for all 3 dresses were the exact same dress 3 times. It is very obvious that they are the same dress, even though anyone with half a brain can see that those dresses were actually completely different shades of red and completely different materials. Customer services have been next to useless.

reviews.review_text:
My experience with SHEIN’s customer service has been one of the most frustrating I’ve had with any online retailer.

I have tried on multiple occasions to return items, but every time I have contacted customer service, I have been given the impression that the issue would be resolved, only for nothing to happen. I repeatedly had to start the process all over again, explain everything from the beginning, and was passed from one agent to another without anyone actually taking ownership of the problem. After 8 months still not able to return. 

The customer service is incredibly poor. Responses feel scripted, promises are made but never followed through, and there seems to be no accountability whatsoever.

What concerned me most was that when I asked to escalate my complaint, I was told there was no manager I could speak to and no email address where I could submit a formal complaint. I found it unbelievable that a company of this size appears to have no way for customers to escalate unresolved issues.

As a loyal customer, this has been extremely disappointing. I don’t mind when mistakes happen, every company makes them, but what matters is how those mistakes are handled. Unfortunately, SHEIN has failed at every stage. I’ve wasted a huge amount of time chasing something that should have been straightforward.

Until SHEIN invests in competent customer service and a proper complaints process, I would think very carefully before ordering from them again. I won’t be!

reviews.review_text:
I placed an order for au pair of shoes. Promised a delivery within three business days, latest arrival 1st July. Needless to say this did not arrive. Not only has it not arrived. It also has not even shipped yet. So I contacted customer service to cancel this order because now it is too late. The reason for the order will have passed by the time it gets here. It is not an unreasonable request to cancel an order that has not even shipped. Having the displeasure of dealing with your customer service representative and hearing  a lot of apologies and they will expedite the order, they obviously did not understand that I don’t need the order anymore. You haven’t shipped it just cancel it and refund my money. But because you choose not to empower your employees to make any common sense decisions they are unable to complete a simple task. You think it is better to continue with the shipment and then having me refuse it or have to return it and incur more cost is the better and sensible solution. This conversation went in circles to an absurd length and all I got was more apologies and will get it shipped as soon as possible. Obviously, no solution was reached. I am absolutely appalled by the treatment I received and cannot believe that your company operates in this manner. 
*********************************************

UPDATE 

Absolutely useless response from Shein.  They are proceeding to ship this order that I have repeatedly asked to cancel. 

Here is the interesting bit. I ordered a pair of Hoka shoes which they claim to be authentic. 
Because Shein is being so unhelpful, I did some checking.  Here is what I found out. 

SHEIN IS NOT AN AUTHORISED SELLER OF HOKA PRODUCTS. 

(You can check the internet for verification. )

So I believe it is in their best interest to cancel the order.

Customer service has been completely unhelpful. They keep repeating the same response instead of taking responsibility or offering a proper solution. No offer of collection, no accountability — just inconvenience for the customer.

It’s unacceptable to send the wrong items and then expect the customer to do all the work to return them, especially when the items are large and heavy.

I will not be ordering from SHEIN again. Save yourself the hassle and shop elsewhere.
